name: High (School) On Sex
description: Wilbert Ross and Denise Esteban. Vivamax brings lots of laughs and loads of sexy time in its new series, “High (School) on Sex”, pronounced as High On Sex,

videos.title: 1st Day High
videos.overview: A new batch of senior high students is coming to Harmon Catholic University – Gibo, Wes, Issa, Mavic and Karla. Gibo befriends his aloof neighbor Issa while BFF’s Mavic & Wes meet new love prospects. And Gibo’s old love, Karla, suddenly returns.

videos.title: Hook-Ups And Downs
videos.overview: With Karla's return, old wounds resurface for Gibo. Issa gives them space to rekindle their romance but it seems fate has other ideas.

videos.title: Lights Off
videos.overview: Mavic finds a new love, the timid Max, who is surprisingly good in bed. More surprising interactions come as Harmon University goes on a retreat.

videos.title: S/Trip
videos.overview: Issa gets involved in a nude scandal again. Despite being busy exploring sex with Mrs. Salva, Gibo helps Issa in finding the culprit, with the help of… Karla?

videos.title: Walang Mali Siya
videos.overview: Max is confused about his sexuality, thanks to his drunk sexual escapade with an awfully familiar face. Confusion also arises between Gibo and Karla, who seems to be hiding something.. or someone.

videos.title: Balikan
videos.overview: Gibo finally got another chance with Karla… or did he? The consequences of the events during the party haunt the horny bunch and decisions are needed to be made to make up for it.

videos.title: Ang Kalat
videos.overview: Gibo ends his sexual relationship with his lover teacher hoping to start anew with Karla. Issa finds comfort in Hunter as she tries to save him again from someone.

videos.title: Pound-Ation Day
videos.overview: Gibo chooses between Karla and Issa while Mavic tries to forgive Wes. A scuffle fueled by revenge arises but despite the chaos, the students come together for one cause.

videos.title: Back in Session
videos.overview: New school, new adventures! Meet the senior high students at Vanguard High Paco, Joanna, Gee, Allaine, Erica, and Brian. Paco's pursuit of his best friend Joanna takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Ms. Holly, the beautiful guidance counselor who challenges his commitment to preserving his virginity.

videos.title: Secret Sexplorations
videos.overview: Brian ventures into Bindr, a dating app where he encounters a deceptive individual. Meanwhile, Joanna unlocks her deepest sexual fantasies through a mysterious package. Eventually, Brian meets his chatmate in person, only to be shocked by their true identity.

videos.title: Pick Me Parade
videos.overview: Erica and Paco go on a date. Erica wears a turtle neck and skirt, mimicking Joanna's style. Despite Erica's efforts, the conversation with Paco becomes awkward. Mr. Ragos announces a Festival of Arts representing various countries, making the students nervous yet excited. Meanwhile, Joanna catches Allaine adjusting her cosplay, leading to a sudden intimate encounter.

videos.title: Dates, Detentions, and Discoveries
videos.overview: We see Joanna praying in her room, asking for forgiveness from the Lord for what she and Allaine did. Gee enters the classroom with a new outfit and a newfound confidence that catches the attention of her classmates. Soon, Gee discovers that Bullet has incurred a debt and is being pursued by menacing goons.

videos.title: Goodbye Sex
videos.overview: Mrs. Holly embraces her son, Brian, feeling guilty about her involvement with Paco, as she doesn't want to ruin the friendship between Paco and Brian. Brian goes to the Pride Org room to pick up and talk to Amber, but she is not there. He only sees a picture of them wearing wedding attire, which leaves him feeling saddened and lonely without Amber.

videos.title: Exposed
videos.overview: Brian decides to dress as a Drag Queen in an attempt to win Amber back. Kate removes Allaine from their group chat. P. Corny unveils a dark secret during the announcement at Vanguard High, sparking anger among the majority of students. Now, it is time for Paco to make a choice about whom he truly loves.
